assets.role: Shared full-pose atlas renderer for actual world characters and portrait previews
assets.source: Authored in this project
assets.review: 6.0: 72 grounded gait/idle frames passed load, border and sole-contact checks; all six direction sets contain eight distinct full-body drawings with upper-body motion. 176 pose combinations passed empty-frame, clipping, partial-alpha and matte checks. Both complete frame sheets visually reviewed. See output/animation-v6-report.json and output/gait-world-v6/report.json for independent world review.
assets.walkCycle: Eight full painted poses per front/side/back for both characters, plus six directional idle drawings; left mirrors the complete side frame. Contact/down/passing/up/opposite-contact poses replace the previous leg rig. One uniform scale per direction; head axis and opaque sole align the cached whole figure. Phase advances with travelled distance; idle retains facing. Original activity poses remain available.
